mapper.select: select tu.id, tu.is_tenant_admin, tu.tenant_id, u.id as user_id, u.account, u.name, u.email, u.phone from sys_tenant_user as tu left join sys_user as u on tu.user_id = u.id where tu.id=#{id} limit 1

select t.id as tenantId, t.name as tenantName, t.code as tenantCode, t.status as tenantStatus, tu.is_tenant_admin as isTenantAdmin from sys_tenant_user as tu left join sys_tenant as t on tu.tenant_id = t.id where tu.user_id = #{userId} and tu.status = 1 and t.deleted = 0 order by tu.create_time desc

select u.id, u.account, u.name, u.phone, u.email, u.dept_id as deptId, d.name as deptName, u.status, u.create_time as createTime from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.id where u.deleted = 0 and u.id not in ( select tu.user_id from sys_tenant_user tu where tu.tenant_id = #{dto.tenantId} and tu.status = 1 )
and u.account like concat('%', #{dto.account}, '%')
and u.name like concat('%', #{dto.name}, '%')
and u.dept_id = #{dto.deptId}
order by u.create_time desc
select u.* from sys_user u inner join sys_tenant_user tu on u.id = tu.user_id where u.status = 1 and u.deleted = 0 and tu.status = 1 order by u.id
